objections.text: Migration 6 drops the withdrawn knowledge module's tables (knowledge_fts, knowledge_entries, knowledge_state, knowledge_shown, knowledge_proposals, promoted_memories) and its two indexes on injections where a store still holds them; that index of project-folder knowledge is lost on such a store. The module never shipped (ADR 0020), so only a development store can hold them, and the module migration pass takes a backup first when a module already had a version.
